title: An unlinked payer is matched to the QuickBooks customer with its exact name
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a test organization connected to a QuickBooks Online sandbox company that you can sign in to.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, not linked to QuickBooks, whose name matches exactly one QuickBooks customer that is linked to nothing.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Complete, ready to invoice, billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Click Create Invoice.
  4. In QuickBooks, open the invoice with work order 1's invoice number.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab shows Create Invoice.

Step 3:

  • The invoice is created.

Step 4:

  • The QuickBooks invoice is on the QuickBooks customer with customer B's exact name.
  • That QuickBooks customer is now linked to customer B.
